justification: Both surfaces divide a vertical field into stacked zones, with a band of repeated small motifs above and larger profile figures below, which is the only real correspondence. Otherwise the depicted content differs entirely: A shows densely costumed human figures with columns of dense sign-blocks rendered in intricate, naturalistic, deeply detailed relief, while B shows isolated schematic animals (a crouching quadruped, a long-necked bird, a zigzag band) with bold, plain outlines and empty ground between them.
